$comment: diagnostics.disable is deliberate, one entry per reason:
missing-fields - plugin specs are option tables whose fields are filled in by the plugin's setup(), so lua_ls reports every spec it cannot see the full type of.
no-unknown - the config touches plugin APIs through require() of modules that are not on this repo's runtime path.
unused-local - locals captured by callbacks and key mappings are used at runtime, not in the file lua_ls analyses.
Nothing else is suppressed: every other lua_ls diagnostic stays on.
